# FazalDataConverter

> FazalDataConverter is a web-based converter for Excel and JSON data. It converts .xlsx, .xls, and .xlsm workbooks to Normal Data JSON or metadata-preserving Workbook JSON, and converts JSON back to Excel. It also supports Excel to binary BSON and data-only extraction from static JavaScript files.

## Key facts

- Supported inputs: .xlsx, .xls, .xlsm, JSON, BSON, and static JavaScript data.
- Maximum input size: 50 MB per file.
- Conversion targets in the documented test environment: up to 10 MB within 10 seconds; up to 50 MB within 60 seconds. Upload and download time is excluded.
- Accuracy target: 100% of officially supported data elements are verified for values, structure, and supported metadata. Unsupported features are reported.
- Safety: macros, embedded scripts, and dynamic code are never executed. Static JavaScript extraction reads approved data only.
- Guests can convert files without an account. An account is required only for saved history and account features.
- File access is scoped per account with server-side ownership validation. Temporary processing files are deleted after conversion, failure, or cancellation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fazaldataconverter.com/): product overview, supported conversions, and frequently asked questions.
- [Converter](https://fazaldataconverter.com/converter): upload a supported file and convert Excel to JSON, JSON to Excel, Excel to BSON, or extract static JavaScript data.
- [About](https://fazaldataconverter.com/about): supported formats, verification coverage, privacy, and security rules.
